Coding agent risks with Supabase: replays and fixes

1 replay involves Supabase: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Supabase db reset on the linked remote project

    Fix: Link the agent only to a staging project, never to production, and use the local stack (supabase start) for resets. Turn on backups for the production project (daily backups are automatic on paid plans, and point-in-time recovery is a paid add-on) and test a restore.

    Replay result: Stopped.
